title: Kavi developmental teaching order and mastery policy
source_policy: Prefer original works and expert-authored educational sources, appropriate to the prerequisite level. Reputation is not a measured intelligence score or a substitute for checking a lesson. Exact original-language editions and local source fingerprints are required.

order.teaching: Keep characters distinct; recognize the tested letters, numerals and writing systems; connect small numbers to exact arithmetic.
Language-specific word formation and meanings alongside addition and subtraction. Shared scripts never imply a shared language.
Sentence order and meaning; multiplication as repeated groups; division and its relation to multiplication.
Fractions, decimals, grammar, short passages and questions whose answers follow from the passage.
Algebra, measurements, elementary science, evidence and explanations.
Logic, original literature, history, philosophy, claims, counterexamples and source comparison.
Discrete mathematics, calculus, further sciences, algorithms and rigorous proofs.
Original papers, reproduction, new questions and independent verification.

current_automation: The unified circuit can execute six narrow foundation stages. Corrective teaching currently supports script-recognition mistakes using Unicode's original reference. Words, sentence meaning, multiplication and division are recorded as missing model capabilities; they cannot be completed by repeatedly running the existing core.
